content:
Implemented and committed recursive agent delegation on branch `recursive-agent-delegation` as commit `e7c4f0b`.

The handler runs delegated agents, returns their text or errors to the delegating agent, and detects circular delegation. The Anthropic provider now advertises and parses delegation tool calls and reconstructs continuation context.

**Verification:** Backend type-checking passed. Mocked checks passed for successful delegation, worker failure, unknown agents, and circular delegation. The handler suite had one failure in abort-controller cleanup; the same failure occurred on `main`. The OpenAI provider suite could not run because an existing test contains `await` outside an async function.
